items.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
items.summary: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

items.title: SlowMist Flags iOS Sandbox Escape Risk to Wallet Data
items.summary: The worse_query repository lists iOS 26.0–26.7.2 and 27.2 as targets; the wallet warning centers on secrets stored locally in plaintext.

items.title: Coinbase, Kalshi and Payward backs CFTC in lawsuit over single-stock perp futures
items.summary: The crypto firms moved for leave to file an amicus brief defending the CFTC's authority to regulate single-stock perpetual futures in the US.
